messages:
Sam: Quick sync — maintenance window for cloud marketplace Terraform modules. Goal: roll minor semver bumps, land CI matrix for marketplace packaging, and add a migration note for partners. Who can own?
Maria: I can drive the module semver + migration note. Do we want to skip any breaking changes?
Raj: no breaking changes in this batch. just small variable renames and provider pin. need to ensure GCP marketplace packaging still passes.
Lucy: I can add the GH Actions matrix for packaging and smoke tests. Will need the ARM/graviton test case added.
Sam: Awesome. Let's call out deliverables: 1) bump modules to v1.4.x (no breaking), 2) add migration.md with quick diffs, 3) GH Actions packaging matrix, 4) marketplace packaging QA for AWS/GCP/Azure.
Maria: Timeline? We have partner release window on Friday (partner-prod cut). Prefer to ship Tues-Wed for internal QA.
Raj: Partner teams require a documented rollback path. I'll draft a short runbook and smoke test checklist.
InfraBot: [deploy-checker] nightly-packaging-matrix failed on arm64: packaging-bundle: exit code 2 — missing libssl-dev in container image. See CI logs: https://ci.redwood.example/packaging/1423
Lucy: thanks InfraBot. I'll add a step to the container build to install libssl-dev and openssl. Also expanding matrix: os: [ubuntu-latest, ubuntu-22.04], arch: [x86_64, arm64], marketplace: [aws, gcp, azure]
Sam: Lucy, can you paste the matrix snippet here so we can iterate?
Lucy: sure:
```yaml
name: Packaging matrix
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, ubuntu-22.04]
        arch: [x86_64, arm64]
        marketplace: [aws, gcp, azure]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup QEMU
        uses: docker/setup-qemu-action@v2
      - name: Build package
        run: ./scripts/build-package.sh --arch ${{ matrix.arch }} --marketplace ${{ matrix.marketplace }}
```
Maria: Nice. For the migration.md I propose sections: overview, diff (old->new variables), known issues per cloud, rollback steps, contact. I'll draft template.
Raj: On testing: partner teams expect an end-to-end deploy smoke test in a partner sandbox. We should capture steps and an automated checklist. I can coordinate with PartnerEng to schedule a sandbox on Wed.
Sam: Good. Also quick note: Azure marketplace requires a separate manifest and has size limits on bundles. Lucy — add a conditional to skip large debug artifacts when marketplace==azure.
Lucy: noted. Will add a compression step and artifact size check.
Maria: I've opened a PR for migration doc draft and semver bump: https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-templates/pull/678
InfraBot: [ci] PR 678: build matrix started — currently queued on arm runners.
Sam: Action items: Maria (migration doc + PR follow-up) by Tue EOD, Lucy (GH Actions matrix + container fix) by Tue noon, Raj (partner sandbox + rollback runbook) by Wed AM. I'll own final QA + ship Friday window.
Lucy: quick question — do we want to land the semver tag automatically on merge? e.g., GitHub action that creates a v1.4.x tag and publishes?
Maria: yes but gated. Tagging action only after CI success and manual approval from Sam.
Raj: I'll also add a partner-facing CHANGELOG short blurb so their integrators know what to expect.
Sam: Sweet. If anything blocks, ping me or drop in #release-war-room. :thumbsup:
Maria: I'll post an update in this thread after PR review.
Lucy: starting the CI fixes now.
InfraBot: [ci] arm-runner allocated — packaging job 1423 re-run queued.
Sam: Thanks team. TL;DR: ship non-breaking module bumps + packaging matrix + migration doc + sandbox smoke tests. Owners noted.
